Side-observations not part of the finding: (1) with `a` UNSET, bash 5.3.15 still prints `a: bad array subscript` but psh prints NO diagnostic at all (both rc=0, stdout empty line); (2) with `v` UNSET, `${v:x!!y:1}` is silent in BOTH shells (bash short-circuits the offset evaluation). Wording differences (`arithmetic error: Division by zero` vs `1/0: division by 0 ...`; `invalid offset or length` vs `arithmetic syntax error`) are the separate A10.3 wording overlap.
